scope: Independent offline source and evidence review only. No target connections, credentials loaded, RF execution, tests rerun, or source modifications by reviewer.
reviewed_corrections: Each read query owns its channel: separate bounded channel opening followed by execution timer started before exec ACK, stream reads and exit status; expiry closes only that channel and prevents success. Nominal query budgets are separately open 6s plus execution 6s.
RF path ping uses half remaining absolute budget for each open/execution component and rejects completion after its original 45s deadline.
Diagnostic success requires status/log/kernel rc0 without stderr, one recognized native WPA state, nonempty log or kernel evidence and exact before/after configuration hash results.

Raw iwconfig radio output is excluded from public diagnostic fields; complete private evidence remains under the private history directory, with public hash only. Credential pointer contents must not be published.
WA close, private evidence failure and AP close are recorded independently; none bypass the AP restoration attempt or final receipt. Any failure or cleanup error prevents acceptance.
unchanged_safety: Exact SSH host pin precedes password authentication; board and full WA bridge MAC checks precede diagnostic queries.
Frozen existing AP guard, legal RF context, bridge isolation and radio-off-before-owned-table deletion remain in use; original nft table names and owned RAM cleanup are required.
No IE pulse, deauthentication, offered load, CPE settings, firmware, protected-partition or production operation is added.

offline_evidence.classification: Coordinator-executed synthetic offline contracts inspected, not independently rerun. New blocked ACK/status fixtures exercise timer-driven owned-channel closure. Prior 70 unchanged contracts are reused revision-bound evidence, not hardware proof.

acceptance_limits: Local admission for one bounded retained-WA-diagnostic acquisition with exact AP restoration only. Actual target ABI, reachability, diagnostic data and restoration remain runtime gates.
This review does not accept PREPROD1, association, reconnection, performance or production readiness. R5l and all earlier failed results remain unchanged.
The superseded four-finding source/plan were archived without RF execution; their failed preflight is not rescored.
